problem.title: Max Chunks to Make Sorted II
problem.problemStatement: Given an integer array that may contain duplicate values, determine the maximum number of chunks into which the array can be partitioned so that sorting each chunk individually results in the entire array being sorted.
problem.input: • First line contains integer N. • Second line contains N integers.
problem.output: Print the maximum number of chunks.
